Yes — that makes it clear I've stepped into a special "picking several" mode. Clicking "Select" brought up a checkbox on each card and a single action bar across the top, so it's obvious the app is now waiting for me to tick some and then choose what to do, rather than my normal browsing. And I like that the actions stay greyed out until I've actually picked something, and that there's a clear "Done" to step back out — so it feels temporary, not a permanent change to how the library looks.

And yes, keeping the library plain until I deliberately turn this on is right. Most of the time I'm just reading and clicking links, so I don't want checkboxes cluttering every card. Bringing them out only when I ask for them keeps the everyday view calm. Good.

I do see Label, Archive, and Delete up there — and being able to tidy a batch that way is great. One thing I'd also expect in that same bar: flagging a batch for "read later" (or clearing that flag) all at once, since that's one of the things I most often do in bulk when I've saved a pile to get through. Can that live alongside the others?
